en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing an old arched stone bridge in a rural or small-town setting. A person with an animal (likely a donkey or horse) stands on the bridge. In the background are trees, low buildings, and at least one tall, slender tower that resembles a minaret. The overall style looks like an early 20th‑century printed postcard. There is a short printed caption at the bottom center of the image, but it is too small and blurred to read clearly.
